BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE task
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS task_kind,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS execution_mode,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS evaluation_mode,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS ui_mode,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS submission_mode,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS requires_sandbox,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS exposes_preview,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS exposes_terminal,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS supports_live_validation;

COMMIT;
